how: Studios run beginner oil painting trial classes and multi-session courses with all materials supplied.
Watercolour landscape masterclasses and workshops are offered by Visual Arts Centre and shophouse studios like Artify.

how: Weekly evening classes and trial workshops teach the four gentlemen then birds-and-flowers and landscape.
Guided and open life drawing sessions with live models run at art studios and galleries.

how: Urban Sketchers Singapore holds free monthly sketchwalks at different places on the island.
Many studios offer one-off wheel throwing taster classes with glazing and firing included.
Family-run Thow Kwang Pottery Jungle (since 1965) offers hand-building sessions with firing in its kiln.
Tombalek runs beginner hot-shop glassblowing classes at Singapore's only public glass melting furnace; glass artist B. Jane Cowie also teaches.
Short beginner flameworking sessions make small glass pieces like mini bouquets.
Small-group suncatcher workshops teach cutting, grinding, foiling and soldering.
venue: Felicia Yong stained glass workshop (via Pelago)

how: Tombalek is listed as teaching blacksmithing and a bladesmithing workshop for forging a knife; schedules were not confirmed.
Studios in Haji Lane and elsewhere run wallet and cardholder workshops with vegetable-tanned leather and tools provided.
Beginner workshops build a side table or memory box in small groups with tools and safety briefing.
Beginner frame-loom wall hanging classes and Saori freestyle weaving sessions are offered.
Two-hour batik painting workshops with Singapore motifs run weekly; tjanting wax-resist workshops also exist.
Short workshops and a 12-lesson course teach brush calligraphy with ink and brushes provided.
venue: NTU Chinese Calligraphy Workshop / Visual Arts Centre

how: STPI runs beginner printmaking workshops combining screenprint, etching and relief; National Gallery hosted screenprint sessions with STPI.
STPI's Print Fusion workshop included acid-etching copper plates; regular dedicated etching courses were not confirmed.
STPI is a professional lithography workshop and has offered lithography stations at open events; no regular public course confirmed.
Objectifs teaches dos-a-dos, pamphlet and link-stitch binding; Based Book Arts runs Coptic and link-stitch workshops.
venue: Objectifs Centre for Photography and Film

how: Several studios run guided custom-perfume blending sessions, e.g. Oo La Lab in Chinatown.
Small-group scented soy and decorative candle workshops are widely offered.
Beginner crochet classes run inside craft stores and via community centres; yarn shops cluster at People's Park.
Drop-in beginner embroidery workshops with materials provided are run daily by studios.
A 2-hour Nonya beading workshop for beginners has been run with the Peranakan Museum community.
Free or occasional origami sessions exist (Family Central course; Japan Creative Centre workshops) but no regular paid adult classes were found.
Ikebana International Singapore Chapter 135 (since 1969) holds public workshops and members teach Ikenobo, Sogetsu and Ohara schools.
3-hour beginner silversmithing workshops in a Joo Chiat heritage space; ring-making studios in Orchard.
venue: Silversmithing workshop at 229 Joo Chiat Rd

how: LASALLE's continuing education offers an 8-session Sculpture I clay course.

how: Sculpture Society Singapore ran a six-lesson stone carving masterclass in 2018; no current public class confirmed.
Objectifs runs a 6-session Foundational Photography Workshop for beginners; limited loan cameras.
venue: Objectifs Centre for Photography and Film

how: Objectifs' Black & White I workshop teaches shooting film and developing prints in its darkroom.

how: Objectifs' Digital Filmmaking workshop covers scripting through editing for beginners, with cameras supplied.

how: LASALLE offers an Introduction to 2D Animation short course using Krita; open to anyone interested.
Tattoo artists learn via apprenticeships at studios; a fake-skin 'pseudo tattoo' workshop exists for a taste, and it certifies no one.
Several studios teach modern kintsugi repair with resin and gold powder on pottery.
Dedicated tufting studios like WeTuft run walk-in and multi-hour rug tufting sessions.
A 3-hour beginner macrame wall hanging class runs in a Thomson Green home studio with materials provided.
venue: Macrame wall hanging workshop (via Seek Sophie)

how: No public ice-carving class was found; local ice sculptors say they have never carved ice in Singapore and train abroad, and Snow City only displays ice sculptures.
Natural snow does not exist in the tropics; real snow sculpting means travelling to places like Sapporo or Harbin.
